summary: Example group_vars/cnos.yml with network_cli, community.network.cnos, vaulted passwords, become enable and optional proxy; drop password with keys and proxy for direct access.
questions: What should group_vars look like for CNOS switches?

answer_card.title: CNOS group_vars example
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
ansible_connection: ansible.netcommon.network_cli
ansible_network_os: community.network.cnos
ansible_user: myuser
ansible_password: !vault...
ansible_become: true
ansible_become_method: enable
ansible_become_password: !vault...
ansible_paramiko_proxy_command: '-o ProxyCommand="ssh -W %h:%p -q bastion01"'
```
Remove `ansible_password` if using SSH keys, and the proxy command for direct access. SSH passwords can't go in `ProxyCommand`.
